scope: bounded exploratory representation study; no Stage 5B implementation
population_requested: five historical Learned, Stage3B Q-only, classical and Haar
population_available: archived native LEARNED_0; two deterministic Haar controls; OFDM/OTFS/AFDM/IDENTITY; missing targets remain missing
primary_family: F^H D times independent complex two-angle Givens multiscale layers
fit_selection: minimum native complex squared Frobenius/N, including step zero; nested per restart; no BER selection
synthetic_gates: N8 algebra; N64 known-family targets at every pass/topology with identical optimizer budget; relative error <1e-4 qualifies that tested fitter
operator_arm: omit redundant optimization if exact labeled DD family identifies W up to global phase; evaluate held-out discrepancies regardless
conditional_alternative: one free-diagonal phase FFT cascade, only if primary residual diagnostics justify; freeze separate amendment before execution

communication.paired: physical H, transmitted bits, physical noise shared across waveforms
communication.noninferiority: candidate BER - 1.10*teacher BER; channel-paired one-sided 95% upper bound <0
communication.multiplicity: pointwise intervals, no simultaneous family-wide preservation claim

frozen_communication_candidates: all Learned_0 primary fits selected by representation objective at each pass/topology, exact-Givens equivalence, teacher and all classical controls; conditional alternative if frozen before final-bank use

timing.setup: compile measured separately; native cached factor actions versus dense BLAS; one CPU thread

stop: no blind depth scaling beyond four passes, no new waveform training, no remote jobs; failed positive controls imply optimization uncertainty
